[[File:Nerve_Gas.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Nerve gas being used.]]
'''Nerve toxin''', also know as '''nerve gas''' or '''nerve agent''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a paralyzing [[Poison gas/Legends|poison gas]]. Such toxic agents were employed by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried darts with a nerve toxin, which he once used in a fight against [[Jodo Kast]]; Fett also kept the antidote for the toxin on his person. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] troops also used non-lethal gas that incapacitated an enemy for a limited duration of time. [[Natasi Daala]] used this to execute the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].
